acquisition_arms.N: natural graph-private provider initialized from the fixed P2-corrupted graph
acquisition_arms.E: same provider and graph, with a public-achievement-only A-then-B-then-C acquisition instrument

instrument: acquisition E only: target A while A is unfinished; after A target B while B is unfinished; after B target C while C is unfinished; after C use the ordinary graph provider
instrument_boundaries: public achievement state only; no direct graph/evidence write, no hidden state read, no policy input, and absent from evaluation
update: identical first-hit updater in N and E; only real public environment first hits add earlier-to-later positive and reverse counterevidence; flush at each 1000-action boundary or terminal
pairing: within controller/world/stream, N/E acquisition share initial corrupted graph and controller/stream/world/action uniforms, and provider target uniforms whenever applicable; evaluation O/F/N/E share world, target uniforms and action uniforms
freeze: after acquisition world 40, N/E graphs freeze; evaluation has no instrument, graph update, or optimizer step
primary: exposure manipulation: real B-before-C pair evidence
target recovery: TV(N,O)-TV(E,O) over the same 31 noncomplete masks, n=8 independent controller-stream chains
behavior: R(E)-R(N), n=100 independent evaluation worlds
analysis_policy: CI and SESOI are descriptive, not gates; no rerun, added sample, or instrument tuning for positive, zero, or negative results
